If a message is received from the remote control, receipt is indicated on the tester for 3 seconds. Then, the display is erased (blanks). A new message overwrites the display. The display shows the key number (00 .. 99) as transmitted in the data message. For radios without such a connection, the radio responds with -Block-No Acknowledge UB-
